description: DomainLens v2 — LLM pre-scan, structured enrichment, business rules extraction, relations synthesis, 3 new MCP tools, incremental rebuild/watch, agent mode extensions, and CLI polish

userStories.title: Add new config fields and restructure skill output directories
userStories.description: As a developer configuring DomainLens, I want the config type and init defaults to include rules_paths, rules_batch_size, and watch_interval_seconds, so that business rule extraction and watch behavior are configurable. I also want technical rules output to move from skills/rules/ to skills/rules/technical/ to separate them from business rules.
acceptanceCriteria: DomainLensConfig type in src/types.ts includes rules_paths, rules_batch_size, watch_interval_seconds
init command generates config.json with the new fields and correct defaults
Technical rules (naming-conventions, soft-delete, performance) are written to skills/rules/technical/ instead of skills/rules/
Business rules still use skills/rules/business/ (no change needed, path is new)
All internal references to skill paths are updated consistently
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement LLM pre-scan for implicit concept discovery
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user, I want the discover pipeline to run an LLM pre-scan step before code scanning, using the file tree + schema summary to discover implicit business concepts (like RecurringOrder, ChurnedCustomer) that have no direct table in the database. The pre-scan output must be merged with heuristic-derived concepts.
acceptanceCriteria: New LLM pre-scan function sends file tree + schema summary to llm_model and returns JSON array of concept names
Pre-scan runs as step 3 in discover pipeline, before code scanner
Suprimido por --no-enrich
Entity merge algorithm implemented: normalized name comparison, heuristic-signaled concepts win, LLM-only concepts get source: ai-inferred with signals: []
Merged list feeds into enrichment step
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Split enrichment into structured enrichDomainConcept and enrichBusinessRule
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user, I want the generic enrichConcept function replaced by two separate structured functions: enrichDomainConcept (with fixed sections: Definition, States & Lifecycle, Business Rules, Related Concepts, Common Query Patterns) and enrichBusinessRule (with sections: Rule Description, Trigger, Conditions, Effect, Where Enforced). Both use max_tokens 1500 and generate semantically-derived tags.
acceptanceCriteria: enrichDomainConcept() exists with structured prompt, fixed sections, max_tokens 1500
enrichBusinessRule() exists with structured prompt, fixed sections, max_tokens 1500
Tags are generated semantically by LLM, not derived from filename
Old generic enrichConcept is removed or no longer used for domain/rules
Domain skills output uses the v2 markdown format with all 5 sections
Business rule skills output uses the FR-006 markdown format
Re-execution behavior preserved: new skills get full content, existing get ## Detected Changes appended
--no-enrich and --dry-run flags work with both functions
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement business rules extraction pipeline
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user, I want the discover pipeline to automatically extract real business rules from service, validator, and policy files. The pipeline should have a deterministic first pass (regex candidate detection based on business vocabulary and conditional density) followed by a batch LLM extraction via extractBusinessRules() that produces structured JSON rules. Duplicate rules across batches should be merged by name with accumulated enforced_in paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Deterministic candidate detection scans rules_paths for high-density business conditionals
Candidate files are sent to extractBusinessRules() in batches of rules_batch_size
extractBusinessRules() returns structured JSON with name, description, trigger, conditions, effect, enforced_in, related_concepts
Duplicate rules across batches are merged by appending enforced_in values
Each unique rule passes through enrichBusinessRule() to produce the .md file
Business rules are written to skills/rules/business/
Integration into discover pipeline after domain enrichment
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement relations synthesis (relations.md)
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user, I want the discover pipeline to generate a relations.md file that connects all domain concepts and business rules in a navigable knowledge map. The file should have 4 fixed sections: Domain Map, Concept Relations, Cross-Concept Rules, and Entry Points. It must be fully regenerated each time (never appended).
acceptanceCriteria: generateRelationsMap() function exists and reads all skills/domain/*.md and skills/rules/business/*.md
Produces skills/domain/relations.md with exactly 4 sections: Domain Map, Concept Relations, Cross-Concept Rules, Entry Points
Fully regenerated each time (not appended) — user can set source: human to skip
Runs at end of discover pipeline after enrichment and business rules
Can run standalone via --relations-only flag (handled in US-012)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add 3 new MCP tools: get_concept, get_rules_for_concept, get_relations
userStories.description: As an AI agent using DomainLens via MCP, I want three new structured navigation tools: get_concept returns frontmatter + parsed sections (no raw markdown), get_rules_for_concept filters business rules by related_concepts in frontmatter (authoritative source), and get_relations returns the relevant portion of relations.md for a given concept. All tools should return structured not-found responses instead of errors.
acceptanceCriteria: get_concept(name) returns { name, type, source, tags, sections: Record<string, string> } or { name, found: false } if not found
get_rules_for_concept(concept, limit?) filters by related_concepts frontmatter, returns array of matching rules or empty array if none
get_relations(concept) returns { concept, direct_relations[], cross_concept_rules[] } or empty arrays if not found
get_relations filters relations.md content for concept-specific relations and cross-concept rules
All new tools registered in MCP server alongside existing 4 tools (total 7)
Not-found responses are structured (not errors) for all three tools
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Extend agent mode interface and enrichment skip logic
userStories.description: As a developer using --agent mode, I want the AgentConcept interface to include optional fields for states, business_rules (flat string array), and related_concepts. When the agent returns a concept with these fields populated, enrichDomainConcept should be skipped for that concept. The agent's initial context should only show domain and business_rule skills.
acceptanceCriteria: AgentConcept interface extended with states?: string[], business_rules?: string[], related_concepts?: string[]
Agent runner passes these fields through from finish() to the pipeline
Enrichment skip logic: if concept has at least one optional field populated, skip enrichDomainConcept
Agent initial context filters existing skills to only domain and business_rule types
Concepts without optional fields still go through enrichDomainConcept normally
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement file-concept-map v2 with expanded format
userStories.description: As a developer using incremental rebuild, I want the file-concept-map.json to use an expanded format with version, lastProcessed timestamp, and per-concept type information. This enables the incremental rebuild engine to know exactly which enrichment function to call for each affected concept.
acceptanceCriteria: File-concept-map uses v2 format: { version: 2, files: { [path]: { lastProcessed, concepts: [{ name, type }] } } }
Write and read utility functions for the map
Map is updated at end of each discover run
Old v1 format is not read (breaking change is acceptable for v2)
Listed in .gitignore generated by init
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement incremental rebuild engine via git diff
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user, I want the system to detect changes via git diff HEAD (staged + unstaged) and git ls-files --others (untracked), cross-reference with file-concept-map, and selectively re-enrich only affected concepts. Deleted files should log a warning and stamp the concept with 'source file deleted' without auto-removing it. Git-unavailable environments should log a clear fallback message.
acceptanceCriteria: Detects modified files via git diff HEAD --name-only
Detects new untracked files via git ls-files --others --exclude-standard
Cross-references changed files with file-concept-map to identify affected concepts and their types
Selective re-enrichment calls correct function (enrichDomainConcept or enrichBusinessRule) per concept type
Deleted source files log warning and append 'source file deleted' to concept's Detected Changes
No git available: logs ⚠ message with manual fallback instruction
Re-generates relations.md if any concept is updated
Re-embeds only changed files on hash check
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement domainlens watch command
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user, I want a watch command that runs the incremental rebuild in a loop with configurable polling interval (default 30s). It should support --no-enrich for cost-limited environments. If filesystem events are available via chokidar, use them instead of polling as a fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: domainlens watch command exists and runs incremental rebuild in a polling loop
Polling interval configurable via watch_interval_seconds (default 30s)
--no-enrich flag suppresses LLM calls, only updates detected signals
Output shows: changed files, affected concepts, enrichment results, relations regeneration, re-embedding
Uses chokidar for filesystem events if available, falls back to polling
Graceful error handling: failed cycle logs error and continues
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Update embedding pipeline to include business rules and relations
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user, I want business rules (one excerpt per file) and relations.md (split by section into 4 excerpts) to be vectorized in the embedding pipeline alongside existing content. Hash-based incremental updates should apply to the new content types.
acceptanceCriteria: Each business rule file in skills/rules/business/*.md generates one embedding excerpt
relations.md generates 4 excerpts (one per section: Domain Map, Concept Relations, Cross-Concept Rules, Entry Points)
New content types use hash-based incremental update (existing behavior preserved)
Embeddings triggerable via --embeddings flag on discover
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add --relations-only flag and update status command
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user, I want a --relations-only flag on discover that regenerates relations.md from existing skills without re-running extraction. I also want the status command to show business_rules, technical_rules, domain_map, relations status, and watch status. --relations-only should error with a clear message if no domain skills exist yet.
acceptanceCriteria: --relations-only flag on discover skips schema, code scan, enrichment, and embeddings
--relations-only errors with message if no domain skills exist
Status output shows: business_rules count, technical_rules count, domain_map status, relations.md checkmark/status, watch status
Status example matches PRD format
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add agent_batch_size and agent_strategy config fields
userStories.description: As a developer configuring DomainLens, I want two new config fields — agent_batch_size (files per sub-agent, default 40) and agent_strategy ('single' | 'multi', default 'multi') — so that I can control whether the agent uses a single session or the multi-session exploration strategy.
acceptanceCriteria: DomainLensConfig type in src/types.ts includes agent_batch_size?: number and agent_strategy?: 'single' | 'multi'
init command generates config.json with agent_batch_size: 40 and agent_strategy: 'multi'
Both fields are documented in the config table comment block
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement mapping phase (Phase 1 of multi-session exploration)
userStories.description: As a developer implementing multi-session exploration, I want a lightweight mapping function that runs a short LLM session to list directories and glob files, producing file groups partitioned by module/directory — without reading any file content — so the total cost is ~1-2k tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: New function buildFileGroups(config, projectPath) exists in src/agent/
Uses a short LLM call that only calls list_directory and glob_files (no read_file)
Agent session terminates early once it has enough file paths (no finish() needed — just returns file paths from tool call history)
Falls back to a simple walkdir grouping (by top-level code_path subdirectory) if the LLM call fails
Returns string[][] where each inner array is a batch of file paths up to agent_batch_size
Respects ignore list from config
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add file_filter support to agent runner for sub-agent sessions
userStories.description: As a developer implementing multi-session exploration, I want the agent runner to accept an optional file_filter (string[]) parameter that restricts read_file calls to only the specified paths, so each sub-agent only explores its assigned batch and cannot drift into other modules.
acceptanceCriteria: runAgent() accepts an optional file_filter?: string[] in RunAgentOptions
When file_filter is set, read_file calls for paths not in the filter return an error string: 'Error: file not in assigned batch'
list_directory and glob_files are not restricted (the agent can still navigate to find its files)
System prompt includes the assigned file list when file_filter is set: 'You are assigned to explore these files: ...'
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement consolidation of multi-agent concept results
userStories.description: As a developer implementing multi-session exploration, I want a consolidation function that merges AgentConcept[] arrays from multiple sub-agent sessions — deduplicating by normalized name, merging signals and related_concepts, and resolving cross-module relations — so the pipeline receives a single unified list.
acceptanceCriteria: New function consolidateConcepts(batches: AgentConcept[][]): AgentConcept[] exists in src/agent/
Deduplication: concepts with the same name (case-insensitive) are merged into one
Merged concept: signals arrays are concatenated and deduplicated by value
Merged concept: related_concepts arrays are unioned
Merged concept: definition from the batch with more signals wins; other definition appended as alternate if substantially different
Merged concept: states and business_rules arrays are unioned
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Wire multi-session strategy into agent runner dispatch
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user running discover --agent on a large codebase, I want the agent runner to automatically use the multi-session strategy (Phase 1 mapping → Phase 2 sub-agents → Phase 3 consolidation) when agent_strategy is 'multi', and fall back to the existing single-session flow when it is 'single'.
acceptanceCriteria: runAgent() checks config.agent_strategy; routes to multi-session flow when 'multi' (default), single-session flow when 'single'
Multi-session flow: calls buildFileGroups(), then runAgent() with file_filter per group, then consolidateConcepts()
Progress output shows phase headers: '▶ Phase 1: Mapping files...', '▶ Phase 2: Exploring batch N/M...', '▶ Phase 3: Consolidating results...'
If buildFileGroups() fails or returns a single group, falls back to single-session silently
agent_max_context_tokens still applies per sub-session (not globally)
forceSummarize() is still invoked per sub-session when its context limit is hit
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add agent_parallel_sessions config field
userStories.description: As a developer configuring DomainLens, I want a new config field agent_parallel_sessions (default 3) that controls how many sub-agent sessions run in parallel during multi-session exploration, so that I can tune parallelism vs. rate limit pressure.
acceptanceCriteria: DomainLensConfig type in src/types.ts includes agent_parallel_sessions?: number
init command generates config.json with agent_parallel_sessions: 3
Field documented in the config table comment block
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Parallelize sub-agent sessions with a concurrency pool
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user, I want the Phase 2 sub-agent sessions to run in parallel using a concurrency pool limited by agent_parallel_sessions, so that exploration of large codebases is faster without overwhelming the LLM provider's rate limits.
acceptanceCriteria: Phase 2 runs sub-agents concurrently using Promise.all() with a pool that caps at agent_parallel_sessions concurrent sessions
Pool implemented with p-limit or an equivalent lightweight semaphore (no new heavy dependency)
Progress output updated: '▶ Phase 2: Exploring N batches (up to X parallel)...' and per-batch '  ✓ Batch 2/5 — 7 concepts found'
429 rate limit errors are still handled by the existing callWithRetry backoff per sub-session
Overall result is identical to sequential execution (order of concepts in final list may differ)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Sanitize concept names before using as skill filenames
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user, I want concept names with special characters (/, \, ↔, →, parentheses) to be safely converted to valid filenames, so that skills are created without ENOENT errors and MCP lookups work correctly regardless of concept name content.
acceptanceCriteria: New utility function toSkillFilename(name: string): string added in src/utils/ that replaces '/' and '\' with '-', removes non-filesystem-safe special characters (↔, →, :, *, ?, ", <, >, |), normalizes multiple spaces to one, and trims
domainSkills.ts uses toSkillFilename(concept.concept) for the .md file path, while keeping the original concept.concept in the frontmatter name: field
businessRulesSkills.ts uses toSkillFilename(rule.name) for the .md file path, while keeping the original rule.name in the frontmatter name: field
MCP server get_skill, get_concept lookup sanitizes args.name with toSkillFilename before comparing against filenames
MCP server also falls back to scanning frontmatter name: field if filename match fails, so existing unsanitized files still resolve
Concept 'Stock / Quantity' creates file 'Stock - Quantity.md' without error
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix file group key calculation to be relative to code_path, not projectPath
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user with a deep code_paths config (e.g. 'src/domain/'), I want file batches to be grouped by the first subdirectory inside each code_path (e.g. 'Order', 'Customer'), not by the first two segments from the project root, so that multi-session exploration actually distributes work across modules instead of collapsing everything into one group or exploding into one group per file.
acceptanceCriteria: partitionIntoGroups in src/agent/mapper.ts computes the group key as: find which code_path the file belongs to, strip that prefix, then use the first path segment of the remainder as the key
buildFallbackGroups applies the same key logic
For code_paths: ['src/domain/'] and file 'src/domain/Order/Entities/Order.php', key is 'src/domain/Order'
For code_paths: ['src/'] and file 'src/Order.ts' (flat), key is 'src/' (all flat files grouped together, not one group per file)
For a file that matches no code_path prefix, falls back to the original first-two-segments logic
Oversized groups (> agent_batch_size) still get split into chunks
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Standardize skill filenames and frontmatter name to snake_case
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user, I want all skill filenames and their frontmatter name: field to use snake_case (e.g. stock_quantity.md, name: stock_quantity), so filenames are consistent, shell-safe without quoting, and match the MCP lookup convention already shown in the PRD examples. Supersedes the filename sanitization approach described in US-020.
acceptanceCriteria: toSkillFilename(name: string): string in src/utils/ converts to snake_case: lowercase, spaces and hyphens to underscores, removes all non-alphanumeric chars except underscores, collapses multiple underscores to one, trims leading/trailing underscores
Examples: 'Stock / Quantity' → 'stock_quantity', 'Advertisement (Ad)' → 'advertisement_ad', 'Integration (Marketplace ↔ ERP)' → 'integration_marketplace_erp', 'SKU (Seller SKU)' → 'sku_seller_sku'
domainSkills.ts uses toSkillFilename(concept.concept) for both the .md filename and the frontmatter name: field
businessRulesSkills.ts uses toSkillFilename(rule.name) for both the .md filename and the frontmatter name: field
MCP server get_skill, get_concept, get_rules_for_concept lookups apply toSkillFilename to args.name before comparing against filenames
MCP server falls back to scanning frontmatter name: field if filename match fails (backward compat with old Title Case files)
Concept 'Stock / Quantity' creates file 'stock_quantity.md' with frontmatter 'name: stock_quantity' without error
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix MIN_FILE_READS to respect file_filter size in sub-agent sessions
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user running multi-session exploration, I want sub-agents with small batches (fewer than 5 files) to be allowed to call finish() after reading all their assigned files, instead of being re-prompted to read more files that don't exist in their filter and entering an error loop.
acceptanceCriteria: In runSingleSession, when file_filter is defined, effective MIN_FILE_READS = Math.min(5, file_filter.length)
Sub-agent assigned 3 files reads all 3 and calls finish() without receiving the re-prompt
Single-session mode (no file_filter) keeps MIN_FILE_READS = 5 unchanged
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix getExploredDirs to track requested paths from tool_calls, not tool results
userStories.description: As a DomainLens developer, I want the early-exit check in the mapping phase to correctly detect when all code_paths have been explored, so the LLM mapping session terminates as soon as coverage is complete instead of always running all MAPPING_MAX_ITERATIONS iterations.
acceptanceCriteria: getExploredDirs in src/agent/mapper.ts reads the path argument from assistant tool_calls where function name is 'list_directory', instead of parsing 'dir  name' lines from tool result content
Implementation iterates messages where role === 'assistant', checks tool_calls array, extracts args.path for list_directory calls
allCodePathsCovered check correctly matches explored paths against config.code_paths (e.g. 'src/' matches when 'src/' or 'src/domain' was requested)
When all code_paths are covered and filePaths.size > 0, the mapping loop breaks early instead of running remaining iterations
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix mergeDefinition signal count comparison in consolidator
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user, I want the consolidation phase to correctly pick the richer definition when two sub-agents discover the same concept, so that the concept with more evidence wins instead of always keeping the first-seen definition.
acceptanceCriteria: In consolidateConcepts in src/agent/consolidator.ts, capture existing.signals.length into a local variable before calling mergeSignals()
mergeDefinition receives the pre-merge existing signal count (or is refactored to receive it) so the comparison 'incoming.signals.length > originalExistingCount' is correct
Sub-agent A finds Order with 3 signals, sub-agent B finds Order with 8 signals — after consolidation, the definition from sub-agent B is used
When counts are equal after comparison, existing definition is kept (no change in behavior)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Improve database connection error message when PostgreSQL client connects to MySQL
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user with a MySQL database, I want to see an actionable error message when the PostgreSQL client accidentally connects to MySQL (error: received invalid response: 4a), instead of a cryptic hex byte, so I know exactly how to fix the configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: In extractSchemaPostgres catch block, detect when the error message includes 'invalid response' or '4a' and log an additional hint: 'Hint: this may be a MySQL server. Set db_type: "mysql" in .domainlens/config.json'
The original error is still logged for debugging
The hint does not appear for other connection errors (e.g. wrong password, host unreachable)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add interactive setup wizard to domainlens init
userStories.description: As a new DomainLens user, I want the init command to ask me guided questions before writing config.json, so I don't accidentally leave wrong defaults (like db_type: postgres on a MySQL project) that cause cryptic errors later.
acceptanceCriteria: When config.json does not exist, init enters wizard mode and prompts interactively via readline before writing anything

Wizard asks: (1) Database type — options: postgres / mysql / none, default detected from existing DATABASE_URL env var protocol if available; (2) Env var name for database URL — default: DATABASE_URL; (3) Env var name for LLM API key — default: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
Wizard auto-detects code_paths by checking which of src/, app/, lib/ exist in the project root and pre-selects them; user can confirm or type a custom comma-separated list
Generated config.json uses the answers from the wizard instead of hardcoded defaults
If config.json already exists, wizard is skipped and existing behavior ('already exists — skipping') is preserved
Non-interactive mode: if --yes flag is passed to init, skip wizard and write defaults as before (for CI/scripted use)
After writing config.json, wizard prints a summary of what was configured and next steps
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix --agent mode missing business rules extraction and relations synthesis
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user running discover --agent, I want business rules to be extracted and relations.md to be generated after agent exploration, so that --agent produces the same complete output as the standard pipeline instead of only domain skills.
acceptanceCriteria: runDiscoverAgent in src/commands/discover.ts calls detectCandidates + extractBusinessRules + generateBusinessRulesSkills after generateDomainSkills, mirroring the equivalent steps from runDiscoverStandard
runDiscoverAgent calls generateRelationsMap after business rules generation
file-concept-map update in runDiscoverAgent includes business rule entries (rule.name + enforced_in files), not only domain concept signals
Progress output shows the new steps with correct step numbering
Final summary line includes business rule counts alongside domain skill counts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Handle non-interactive stdin in agent file limit prompt
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user running discover --agent in a non-interactive environment (CI, Docker, piped stdin), I want the file limit prompt to not hang indefinitely waiting for input that will never come, so the process terminates gracefully instead of blocking.
acceptanceCriteria: In runSingleSession in src/agent/runner.ts, before calling promptYesNo, check process.stdin.isTTY
If stdin is not a TTY, skip the prompt, assume 'N' (do not continue), log: 'Non-interactive environment — stopping at file limit. Increase agent_max_files in config to explore more files.'
If stdin is a TTY, existing promptYesNo behavior is preserved
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add result cap to glob_files tool to prevent token explosion
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user, I want glob_files to cap its output at 500 results and show a truncation notice, so that broad patterns like **/*.php on large codebases don't dump thousands of paths into the agent context and cause token accumulation issues.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/agent/tools.ts, add MAX_GLOB_RESULTS = 500 constant
globFiles stops collecting after MAX_GLOB_RESULTS matches
When results are truncated, a final line is appended: '(truncated — showing 500 of N total matches. Use a more specific pattern.)'
When results are not truncated, no notice is added
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix hardcoded noEnrich: true in runDiscoverAgent ignoring per-concept skipEnrich logic
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user running discover --agent, I want concepts that the agent returned without states/business_rules/related_concepts to be enriched via enrichDomainConcept(), and only concepts with those fields populated to skip enrichment, so that --agent produces richer skills instead of always generating skeletons.
acceptanceCriteria: In runDiscoverAgent in src/commands/discover.ts, replace noEnrich: true with noEnrich: options.noEnrich ?? false when calling generateDomainSkills

convertAgentConcepts already sets skipEnrich: true when agent provided states/business_rules/related_concepts — this per-concept flag continues to take precedence over noEnrich in generateDomainSkills
Running discover --agent without --no-enrich calls enrichDomainConcept() for concepts where skipEnrich is false
Running discover --agent --no-enrich skips enrichment for all concepts (existing behavior preserved for explicit opt-out)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix getExistingSkillNames to read frontmatter name: instead of filename
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user running discover --agent on a project with existing skills, I want the agent's existing skill list to use the frontmatter name: field as the source of truth, so that after filenames are standardized to snake_case (US-022) the agent still recognizes already-documented concepts and avoids rediscovering them as duplicates.
acceptanceCriteria: getExistingSkillNames in src/commands/discover.ts extracts the name: field from frontmatter when available, falling back to filename-without-extension if the field is absent
getExistingDomainAndRuleNames applies the same frontmatter-first logic
Both functions already read file content to check type: — the name: extraction reuses the same frontmatter parse without an extra fs.readFileSync call
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Warn and abort incremental rebuild when projectPath is not the git root
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user with a project in a git subdirectory (monorepo), I want a clear warning instead of silent incorrect behavior when the git root differs from the project path, so I understand the limitation instead of getting wrong or missing change detection.
acceptanceCriteria: In detectChangedFiles in src/commands/incremental.ts, after resolving the git root via git rev-parse --show-toplevel, compare path.resolve(root) against path.resolve(projectPath)
If they differ, log '⚠ Git root differs from project path — incremental rebuild requires projectPath to be the git root. Run domainlens discover manually.' and return []
Git commands that do run use the absolute root path as cwd (not the relative gitDir variable)
isGitAvailable check is unaffected
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Graceful shutdown for domainlens watch on SIGINT/SIGTERM
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user running domainlens watch, I want Ctrl+C to wait for the current cycle to finish before exiting, so that skill .md files are never left in a partially-written state due to an abrupt process kill mid-enrichment.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/commands/watch.ts, replace setInterval with a recursive setTimeout loop controlled by a stopping flag
process.on("SIGINT") and process.on("SIGTERM") set stopping = true and log "Stopping after current cycle completes..."
After the current runCycle() promise resolves, the loop checks stopping and calls process.exit(0) instead of scheduling the next cycle
If no cycle is running when the signal arrives, exit immediately
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Replace existing Detected Changes section instead of appending duplicates
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user running domainlens watch over many cycles, I want the ## Detected Changes section in each skill to be replaced on each re-enrichment instead of appended, so that skill files do not grow unboundedly and semantic search does not index repeated content.
acceptanceCriteria: In appendDetectedChanges in src/commands/incremental.ts, before appending check if the file already contains a ## Detected Changes section
If found, replace the existing section (from ## Detected Changes to end of file, or to the next ## heading) with the new content
If not found, append as before
appendDeletedSource applies the same replace-or-append logic
The replacement preserves all content above ## Detected Changes unchanged
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix infinite loop in get_relations MCP tool for non-first concepts
userStories.description: As a DomainLens user querying domain relations via MCP, I want get_relations to correctly iterate over all concept sections in relations.md so that concepts listed after the first entry do not cause the MCP server to hang indefinitely.
acceptanceCriteria:
In src/mcp/server.ts inside the get_relations tool handler, add the /g flag to the regex on line 411: /### (.+?)
([\s\S]*?)(?=
